statement: Each entry records one measured hosted conclusion or one regular merge. Conclusions are read from the run's own record, never inferred from a neighbouring run, a green pull-request run, or a wrapper's exit code. An entry is evidence of what was measured at that moment; it is not a release, a diagnosis, a cure, or an approval. Handovers cite entries here instead of restating them. Entries are appended in measured-time order and never edited except by a later entry that names the correction. Re-measure with tools/measure-evidence-ledger.ps1; validate with tests/Unit/EvidenceLedgerTests.cs.
